paper.title_en: A New Framework to Detect Multi-Messenger Signals from Bright Sporadic Stochastic Gravitational Wave Background
paper.abstract_en: The temporal dependence of the astrophysical stochastic gravitational-wave (GW) background (SGWB) in the hecto-hertz band brings a unique avenue to identify multi-messenger signals to these sources by using coincident detection in both GW and multi-band EM signals. We developed a new analysis pipeline, \textit{Multi-messenger Cross-Correlation} (MC$^2$) that can search for EM counterparts to the SGWB signal originating from both modeled and unmodeled sources by harnessing the nearly full-sky gamma-ray sky map. We provide an observation strategy that can be followed by current and future missions to discover EM counterparts to the weak GW signal hidden in the SGWB. We demonstrate the ability of this technique to drastically reduce the false alarm rates when involving EM multi-band analysis. This formalism aims towards advancing the multi-messenger observation frontier and improving our understanding of the population of bright SGWB sources present in the high-redshift universe and can also be applied to other messengers such as neutrinos in the future.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 尽管涉及随机引力波背景和多信使探测，但论文主题高度特定于引力波天文学和电磁对应体搜索，论文中未提及脉冲星计时阵列，也未涉及广义相对论基础或黑洞热力学，且与凝聚态全息相关的关联性有限。
decision.selection_reason_zh: 该摘要未明确提及脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）或与PTA相关的现象。主要焦点是随机引力波背景的多信使探测，这可能与PTA相关，但摘要中未直接建立联系。
decision.title_zh: 探测明亮间歇性随机引力波背景的多信使信号的新框架
decision.abstract_zh: 天体物理随机引力波背景（SGWB）在赫克托赫兹频段的时间依赖性为通过引力波和多波段电磁信号的联合探测识别这些源的多信使信号提供了独特途径。我们开发了一种新的分析流程，即多信使互相关（MC²），它通过利用近乎全天覆盖的伽马射线天图，搜索来自模型化和非模型化源的SGWB信号的电磁对应体。我们提供了一种观测策略，可供当前和未来的任务遵循，以发现隐藏在SGWB中的弱引力波信号的电磁对应体。我们展示了该技术在涉及电磁多波段分析时大幅降低误报率的能力。该形式体系旨在推进多信使观测前沿，并提高我们对高红移宇宙中存在的明亮SGWB源群的理解，未来也可应用于其他信使，如中微子。
